QUOTE: The empty vector is ambiguous. An empty prompt with `add_special=false` also produces `{}`, so no caller can tell "failed" from "nothing to tokenize."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says failure returns `{}`, which is indistinguishable from a legitimately empty result. It also details callers that don't check (count_tokens returns 0, and generate paths have no empty check).
